note: A1+ Unit 4 Lesson 4.16, built on 2026-11-21 under the A1+ lesson standards approved 2026-10-27 and the user's 2026-11-09 rule that every A1+ lesson follows up the A1 lesson with the same number. The user approved the A1+ Unit 4 map on 2026-11-20 (A1+ 4.Y follows A1 4.Y, one step each; seventeen lessons) and asked for the Unit 2 and Unit 3 deal ("Start working on A1+ Unit 4, same deal. make sure images make sense all the time"): straight to Preview in batches, Gemini 2.5 Flash photos and ElevenLabs audio pre-approved, no per-lesson gates, reviewed in Preview. The review uses eleven new Flash photos of a new family, each an edit of one family photo: the grandfather upstairs, the girl turning on her desk lamp, the dog behind an armchair, the two children reading in the garden, the mother brushing her teeth, the father cleaning the kitchen table, the boy washing the car, the boy giving his grandmother one cup, the girl playing football, the grandmother at her birthday cake and four cups on a kitchen table. Each fact is offered as a picture item, whose wrong pictures are the other photos, and as a sentence item, whose wrong options change only the reviewed form; how often, a date and last week are said and only heard.

lesson.title: 4.16 Review: a family at home
lesson.unit_title: Life at home, every day and yesterday
lesson.unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, talk about the lights and machines, ask what there is, describe someone's morning in order, say what you did yesterday and on which day, ask and tell the time, say how often you do things and give dates.
lesson.goal: Review every A1+ Unit 4 step with a new family at home: upstairs, on and off, behind, there are, the he/she routine and and then, the past with -ed, Did…?, didn't, it after a verb, how often, a birthday date, last week and some and any, with no new language.
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 4.16 Unit 4 Review: A1 reviews Unit 4 with fresh scenes; A1+ 4.16 reviews every A1+ Unit 4 step with eleven fresh Flash photos of a new family (grandparents, parents, a girl, a boy and their dog) and no new language: Where's the grandfather? He's upstairs. (4.1), the lamp is on (4.2), behind the chair (4.3), Are there two children in the garden? (4.4), she brushes her teeth and then she gets dressed (4.5-4.6), he cleaned the table yesterday (4.7), Did he wash the car? Yes, he did. (4.8), he didn't work on Sunday (4.9), he gives it to his grandmother (4.11), every weekend (4.12), her birthday is on May fourth (4.13), last week (4.14) and some cups (4.15). 4.10's clock times stay in 4.10. Nobody in the photos speaks in the first person (the cast's voices belong to the cast), so the teacher asks and the co-teacher answers; how often, a date and a time of the past are said, never read from a picture.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say where a new family is and what they do, did and did not do, how often, when a birthday is, and what there is, with every Unit 4 form, at a natural pace.
